name: Alfonse
source:
Likes: Hot dogs
Dislikes: Being controlled
Hobby: Observing magical plants and magical creatures
Skill: Healing patients

"I...I'm probably not a good person as you think I am."

Hiro: He is one of the most generous and kind-hearted men in the world.
Regardless of who you are, he treats people well.
Unlike me, he is always smiling.
But, it seems like he's hiding something from us...Something important that is heavy on his heart.
Whatever that is, we'll always be there for him.
Well...I'll wait until he is ready to confirm...
